messages:
Marina: Quick heads-up — planning to publish python package 1.4.0 and typescript client 0.9.0 today during the 1pm PT change window. Need sign-off on pinning policy, release notes, and deprecation copy. @Aj @Samir

Aj: Are the package names changing or just the versions? we need to update the pip/registry paths if rename.

Marina: No renames. But we're switching to the new wheel metadata (PEP 621) — build pipeline changed. Packaging artifact names stay the same.

Samir: Is there a known risk for older client users? will pip install suddenly break for py2 consumers? :grimacing: 

Marina: Only risk is if the new build strips legacy metadata; I've validated with a dry-run. But we should pin TS minor to avoid transient semver surprises.

Liz: +1 to pinning. For TS we should publish under tag `rc` first, then promote. That avoids immediate breakage for downstream.

Marina: Plan: 13:00 PT change window. Steps:
- run `./scripts/build && ./scripts/check-artifacts`
- release-bot:publish --packages py,ts --dry-run
- verify smoke tests on nightly registry
- promote tag -> latest

Marina: Changelog snippet to include:
```
1.4.0 (py) — Add streaming-friendly Session API, fix KV cache edge case.
0.9.0 (ts) — Align request/response shapes with new runtime headers, BREAKING: remove legacy sync client.
```

Aj: Breaking notice for TS needs clearer migration notes in README and a deprecation schedule. Suggest: deprecate legacy sync client, leave for two minor releases, then remove.

Samir: Also add a warning log in the sync client runtime so users see migration notice in logs.

Marina: Good. I'll draft deprecation docs and a migration snippet. Want to call out exact removal version: remove in 1.1.0 (TS) — two minors from now.

release-bot: publish job started for packages: rwinference-py@1.4.0, rwinference-js@0.9.0 (job id: 8842)

release-bot: dry-run succeeded, uploaded artifacts to staging-registry

Marina: Kicking off smoke tests now.

DevOps: Smoke failed on Windows wheel import — missing `importlib.metadata` shim. Failing test: install -> import -> instantiate Client.

Aj: ack. Can we hotfix packaging to include `importlib-metadata` as a backcompat dep only for py<3.8?

Samir: yes, add conditional requires in setup.cfg and re-run.

Marina: OK, hold on publishing to `latest`. We'll fix and re-run. Change window still fine — we can promote by 13:25.

Liz: Do we need to notify customers on slack? maybe post in #general if release delayed >30m.

Marina: Agree. I'll update channel if we exceed the window.

release-bot: publish job cancelled by Marina (job id: 8842)

Marina: Patch applied, added conditional dep, rebuilt wheels. New dry-run queued.

release-bot: dry-run succeeded, artifacts uploaded to staging (job id: 8847)

Samir: Verified import on Windows container. smoke: ✅

Aj: Reviewed docs, migration snippet LGTM. I'll hold off tagging `latest` until we get a final sign-off at 13:18.

Marina: Final sign-off: @Liz? @Aj?

Liz: Give me 2 min, checking telemetry hooks.

Liz: Telemetry ok. +1. go for promote.

release-bot: promote job started (id: 8850) — promoting rc -> latest for rwinference-js@0.9.0

release-bot: promote succeeded, packages are live.

Marina: Release complete. I'll post release notes and deprecation schedule in the docs repo and link to the changelog.

DevOps: Reminder: Update the pinning guide in the README to call out `>=1.4.0, <2.0.0` for py and `^0.9.0` for ts if you want breaking-change protection.

Marina: Thanks all. Filing a follow-up doc for the removal timeline. :tada:
